sources.title: La Véritable Astrologie Chinoise

sources.title: François Villée portrait lunaire
sources.quality_notes: Extracted text lines 1679–1695 and note45: 1990 coauthorship, claim of teaching from 1996. Screenshot failed; no independent contemporary apprenticeship or teaching evidence.

sources.title: Guide d’utilisation version 3.0
sources.quality_notes: Printed p3 text attribution of calculation and star placement, pp21/23 interpretation sources. Reproduced manual, not original software or mechanical replay.

sources.title: Tu Vi 4 manuel
sources.historical_period: Version 4 manual; URL path not publication date
sources.quality_notes: French PDF index29–30 visual check, attribution of automatic interpretation and bibliographic references; English version same document family. No full-byte hash; no ancient rule authority.

sources.title: Mise à jour de Tu Vi
sources.quality_notes: Developer-stated solar-time, brightness, multiple-source star placement and Tran-school integration changes. No independently tested rule or exact Chinese star mapping.

sources.title: Le logiciel astrologie chinoise Tu Vi
sources.historical_period: Current public product description; initial date unknown
sources.quality_notes: Author attributions and local-time modules for multiple countries. Software support is not evidence of local adoption, class delivery or lineage.

sources.title: L’astrologie chinoise authentique: notions fondamentales: établissement de thèmes
sources.quality_notes: FRBNF37113260, Nguyen Ngoc-Rao, ISBN2716311404, 408pp, holding 2000-99641. Software title attribution not proof this particular impression was used; original method pages unread.

sources.title: Complete Chinese Horoscopes
sources.quality_notes: Kwok Man-Ho, Martin Palmer, Joanne O'Brien; 1857781813, GBA472770. Open Library same ISBN/OCLC35195676; pagination conflict; original Tzu Wei pages unverified, no claim of full Ziwei system.

sources.title: Formación avanzada en cosmología
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly distinguishes Zi Wei Do Shu from Zi Ping Ba Zi, course focuses on latter. PDF render timed out; no actual delivery or medical efficacy claim.

sources.title: Programma corso di primo livello
sources.quality_notes: Extracted syllabus names Francesco Rossena and eighth session BA-ZI introduction scheduled 2012-05-13; venue pending. PDF render 403; no actual class or lineage.

sources.title: Corsi master architettura Feng Shui
sources.quality_notes: Separate ZI WEI DOU SHU listing lines221–222. Not proof of actual class, earliest Italian teaching or ancient lineage.

sources.title: Zi Wei Dou Shu
sources.quality_notes: Self-reported courses/consultations in Romanian cities and abroad; independent dates, specific events and lineage unverified.

sources.title: Feng Shui Professional Consultant Training Course
sources.quality_notes: Separate Bazi and Ziwei modules; both future relative to access date. Not actual classes; other Portuguese school sites retained as possible related institutional notices.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Developer-stated dependence and version changes are scoped to modern software, not verified ancient rule equivalence or direct historical apprenticeship.
Book catalogues and course announcements do not prove actual teaching or first introduction.
Country time-zone modules do not establish local practice.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Võ Văn Em/Villée imprint and independent apprenticeship; 1981 Kermadec and 1999 Jenny Mai Ngo original catalogue; UK 1995 method pages; actual class delivery and regional lineages; exact star mappings and original software versions.
